process: Alberta upstream facilities reporting pneumatic venting, 2024 (ST60B OneStop venting joined to Petrinex gas handled)
formula: median (p25-p75) over 6697 facilities of (PNEUMATICINSTRUMENT + PNEAMATICPUMP vented m3) / max(gas received, gas produced)
reference: AER ST60B 2025 workbook, sheet 2024 OneStop; Petrinex 2024
note: Whole gas vented, put in t CH4 by the build at the Alberta upstream gas methane content (cf-ng-production-ch4-mass). Facilities with no pneumatic venting are left out, so non-emitting sites do not pull the median down. Facility groups: gas-battery-multiwell 1593, gas-battery-single-well 1496, crude-oil-battery-multiwell 1065, crude-oil-battery-single-well 852, bitumen-battery-cold 740, gas-gathering-system 584, gas-plant-sweet 225, gas-plant-sour 90, in-situ-oil-sands-battery 22, water-disposal 10, in-situ-oil-sands-injection 9, gas-plant-straddle 6, enhanced-recovery-injection 3, gas-plant-fractionation 2.
